name: Jigokudani Monkey Park
description: A protected wildlife viewing park in the Jigokudani valley where visitors can observe Japanese macaques in their natural mountain setting.
highlights: Japanese macaques in a natural mountain setting
A forested approach into the Jigokudani valley
Independent wildlife attraction beyond the broad national-park record

highlights: 自然の山間で暮らすニホンザル
地獄谷の森を歩くアプローチ
広域の国立公園記録とは別に探せる野生動物スポット
